mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4% over a 6-month window signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, which reduces earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above 3% signals robust manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4% and a fall in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 150 million over a 3-month window signals a sharp labor market downturn, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.2 million units signals weakening residential investment and consumer sentiment, which reduces GDP growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 2% signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01.
